summary: This topic provides a general overview of the Admission module's key functionalities, including managing application data, leads, transactions, reports, follow-ups, and lead logs with IVR integration. It highlights that leads progress through various stages, which are customizable per institute.
important_notes: The Admission module includes pages for Application Data, Admission Leads, Transactions, Admission Reports, Follow-up, and Admission Lead Logs.
If IVR (Interactive Voice Response) is integrated, call logs (received, missed, no pick) are directly received and displayed in the ERP under Admission Lead Logs.
Any lead moves from multiple stages before getting admission, and these stages are different for every institute based on client requirements.
